text:
incident-bot: PAGER — inference runtime alert in us-west-2: sustained kv-cache miss rate spike + elevated tail latency on redwood/gpt-xxl. Severity P2. Pager: sam.

sam: I'm on it, switching to incident channel. Lina/Jordan, can you join the live mitigation?

lina: looking at dashboards — kv miss storm hitting keys for gpt-xxl prefix. batch sizes spiked for a subset of flows. quantized variant is falling back intermittently.

jordan: noted. thinking temporary scale-up + targeted eviction. want to avoid full FLUSH.

sam: starting temporary capacity bump and targeted eviction. posting commands now.

sam: ```
# add 2 nodes to inference-prod pool
infractl capacity scale --pool inference-prod --add 2
# evict kvcache keys for gpt-xxl hotset (targeted)
redis-cli -h kv-cache.prod --scan --pattern "kvcache:*gpt-xxl*" | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli -h kv-cache.prod DEL
```

deploy-bot: capacity scale job started (job_id: cap-20260314-881).

maria: any visible customer impact? support seeing errors?

sam: small percent of requests (~0.6%) observed >1.5s latency, a couple of 5xxs in the same window. Not a broad SLO breach but customer-facing errors were reported. Notifying support.

lina: mitigation applied: targeted kvcache eviction + +2 nodes. latency back to baseline in charts. continuing 30m monitoring.

jordan: grabbing logs and core dumps from affected hosts and attaching to incident folder.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: recovered -> auto-resolved.

sam: ok. scheduling postmortem. propose 17:30 UTC tomorrow. who can make it?

lina: I can. initial hunch: cache key churn from new prompt prefix + quant kernel fallback regression after yesterday's runtime rollout.

jordan: agree. suggested action items:
1) add enforced TTL and max-size eviction for per-model kvcache buckets (owner: jordan)
2) implement a safer fallback policy and health-check gating for quantized kernels (owner: lina)
3) add pre-deploy load perf test covering kvcache hotkeys and batching distribution (owner: infra team)
4) postmortem doc + customer comms draft (owner: sam + maria)

jordan: I can take item 1. ETA 2 weeks for implementation + tests.

sam: created tracker INF-2291 and linked the incident. please add estimates and PRs there.

maria: I'll coordinate support/customer comms once postmortem is done. created SUP-487 for the ticket the support team raised.

sam: quick retrospective notes for the postmortem agenda: timeline, root cause analysis, why the current kvcache eviction didn't trigger, rollout changelog for the quant kernel, test gaps, remediation plan and owners, and release gating updates. @lina @jordan add anything else.

lina: I'll add a minimal repro and the replay logs to the postmortem doc. also adding perf traces that show KV miss correlation with batch spikes.

support-bot: Support ticket SUP-487 created: 'Latency spike during inference'. Assigned to maria.

sam: leaving this channel for now. I'll post the calendar invite + postmortem doc link, and the INF-2291 checklist. Action items recap:
- [ ] Jordan: kvcache TTL/size enforcement (INF-2291.1) — ETA 2w
- [ ] Lina: quant fallback policy + pre-deploy gating (INF-2291.2) — ETA 1w
- [ ] Infra: perf test for kvcache hotkeys (INF-2291.3) — ETA 2w
- [ ] Sam/Maria: postmortem writeup + customer comms (INF-2291.4) — ETA 48h

sam: thanks all. will follow up in the postmortem thread.
